## A6 — Portal / Doorway close [LIVE]

*(label)* The Return Face · **The Doorway**

> There is worldly knowledge and there is knowing the mystery of the world — and these are worlds apart. But follow one far enough and you'll meet the other, for the world and its mystery are like son and mother.
>
> The Doorway takes you below the surface — where the app opens into an architecture, and the architecture turns out to be a cosmos that already includes you.
